features.name: Non-resetting bonus

review:
Candy Blitz Bombs is the follow-up to Candy Blitz, keeping the 6x5 pay-anywhere grid but redesigning the multipliers. A side reel holds a multiplier that rises by 1x with each successful tumble and resets when the tumbles stop. Multiplier bombs worth 1x to 500x can also land and are added to that reel when a cascade happens.

Four, five or six scatters award 10, 12 or 14 free spins. In the bonus, bombs start at a minimum of 2x and the multipliers keep accumulating without resetting for the whole feature, which is where the advertised 10,000x maximum comes into reach. The RTP of 96.49% is better than the original. It feels like a meaningful upgrade rather than a reskin.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
